description: This file contains unit tests for the GstProtectionMetadataWrapper class, which manages protection metadata in GstBuffer objects within the Rialto media framework. It uses Google Test framework to verify adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata.

classes.name: RialtoProtectionMetadataTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing GstProtectionMetadataWrapper functionalities.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Test adding protection metadata to a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataDataSuccess
methods.description: Test successful retrieval of protection metadata from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataDataNoMeta
methods.description: Test retrieval when no protection metadata is present in the GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataSuccess
methods.description: Test successful removal of protection metadata from a GstBuffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataFail
methods.description: Test failure to remove protection metadata when removal returns false.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadataNoMeta
methods.description: Test removal attempt when no protection metadata exists in the GstBuffer.
